description: This file manages channel setup, including listing installed channels, resolving workspace directories, and catalog entries for channels in a plugin-based system.

classes.name: ChannelCatalogEntry
classes.description: Represents a catalog entry with an ID and metadata.

classes.name: ResolvedChannelSetupEntries
classes.description: Contains resolved channel setup entries, including installed and installable catalogs.

methods.name: resolveWorkspaceDir
methods.description: Resolves the workspace directory based on configuration and optional override.

methods.name: listManifestInstalledChannelIds
methods.description: Returns a set of channel IDs that are installed according to the plugin manifest registry.

methods.name: isCatalogChannelInstalled
methods.description: Checks if a specific catalog channel entry is installed.

methods.name: resolveChannelSetupEntries
methods.description: Resolves and categorizes channel catalog entries into installed and installable sets.
